summary.text: Heaven's Will Dissipation is a wisdom path killer move that uses heavenly secret Immortal Gu as the core. It targets heaven's will and can get rid of it completely.

claims.text: Old Man Yan Shi created this move but did not succeed. It was only incomplete when Fang Yuan obtained it. Practising the incomplete version cannot activate it, but the process shows Fang Yuan its profundity. Fang Yuan has lower wisdom path attainment than Old Man Yan Shi, but he has the light of wisdom. Several days later he completes the incomplete move. After getting it, he starts to use it on Spring Autumn Cicada.

Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move. After some preparation, grey-white light covers his body. He touches the immortal zombie body with a hand covered in that light. The grey-white light flows like water over the zombie, then eyes appear in it, multicolored like a rainbow. They spread from his palm until they cover the zombie, blink and change colors, then spread into the aperture. Spring Autumn Cicada’s surface is covered by a small layer of colored eyeballs. Each blink is an attack against heaven’s will. Spring Autumn Cicada shakes. Fang Yuan expends red date immortal essence to keep a stream of eyeballs growing. After intense shaking he sees a mild crack on Spring Autumn Cicada’s surface and stops the move too quickly, injuring himself. He cannot continue. At this rate the cracks would enlarge and increase, and Spring Autumn Cicada would be destroyed. Heaven’s will’s influence on it is far deeper than he had expected. One option is to keep modifying the immortal killer move until it can get rid of heaven’s will without harming Spring Autumn Cicada. Deducing it was already near his limit. Progress would take a huge amount of time, effort, and resources.

Fang Yuan also practises this move. He treats it as his greatest success during that period and is not going to give it up. It is a countermeasure that needs to be modified further. It takes a long time to prepare, so it can only be used in the background and cannot be utilized in an actual battle.

Fang Yuan activates the immortal killer move on Thieving Heaven’s dream realm. It is not his first time using the move, but it is his first attempt at using it on a dream realm. Grey-white light flows like water into the dream realm, covers it like a mountain under that light, then stops expanding as multicolored eyes appear, increase from tens to millions, and fill the light on the surface and inside it. The eyes blink as red date immortal essence is expended rapidly and the heaven’s will in the dream realm is wiped out. After a while there is no heaven’s will left in the grey-white light. The light expands again and the eyes move in for more destruction. He activates the move for three days and nights. Eventually none of heaven’s will remains in Thieving Heaven’s dream realm. He keeps a veil of grey-white light around it at all times, so that if heaven’s will tries to invade, the multicolored eyes in the white light destroy it.

Known users.text: Old Man Yan Shi (creator) Fang Yuan
